description: This file contains an implementation of a quantization requantization function optimized for ARM Neon architecture. The function pytorch_qnnp_requantize_precise__neon proceeds to perform per-element scaling, shifting, and quantization of 32-bit integer inputs to 8-bit unsigned outputs, with clamping to specified min and max values.
